findings.location: First paragraph; repeated in the second paragraph
findings.source_quote: “my pager going off” / “the number on the pager”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “kipaji changu” and “kipaji” with “kipajeri changu” and “kipajeri” (or another clear Kiswahili term for a pager). For example: “nikisikiliza kipajeri changu kikiita” and “Niliangalia nambari iliyoonyeshwa kwenye kipajeri.”
findings.translation_quote: “mlio wa kipaji changu ukilia” / “namba iliyoonyeshwa kwenye kipaji”
